english.title: Supply regulated substance to member of public without verifying licence / recognised non-GB licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) supplied a regulated substance, namely **(..SPECIFY REGULATED SUBSTANCE..), to a member of the general public, without first verifying that the member of the general public had a licence, or a recognised non-GB licence to acquire, possess and use that substance
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3A(1) and 8(1) of the Poisons Act 1972.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 3A(2) of the Poisons Act 1972 states in order to verify that someone has a licence or recognised non-GB licence, it is sufficient for these purposes to -

(a) inspect the person's licence, and (b) inspect the form of identification specified in that licence.

(ii) Section 2 gives the meaning of a regulated substance.
(iii) A person does not commit this offence if the requirements for the offence do not apply to the person's case by virtue of regulations made under section 9B.
(iv) See section section 7A which gives the defence of proof of lack of knowledge.
